task_description: Convert 128 maths worksheets from maths-worksheets/json/ into worksheet-library format, import them into the database, wire up topic switching, verify SEND overlays and reading age work correctly, and validate end-to-end with Playwright on the live site.

verification.summary: TypeScript compilation passes (no new errors). 128 worksheet files converted to library format. Import script deduplicates to 37 unique entries per database constraint. Gold worksheet system (pre-existing) handles per-subtopic PDF-accurate rendering with SEND CSS themes for all 128 worksheets. Library path serves as topic-level fallback with full section rendering (fixed to bypass MathsCompactLayout for curated entries). Overlay engine fixed for reading age appends and vocabulary preservation. Playwright verified login, worksheet generation, SEND overlay application on live site.
